basics.name: Arihant Jain
basics.title: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with experience across backend systems, developer platforms, cloud integrations, and full-stack product delivery. Built cost-optimization workflows, security-focused portals, and production APIs using modern web, cloud, and data tooling.

experience.title: Technical Consultant
bullets: Developed a cost-optimization algorithm for cloud migration that reduced storage costs by 30%.
Designed and implemented a portal for SBOM supply chain security, delivering both front-end and back-end functionality.
Integrated APIs and scheduling services for automatic retrieval and updates of product varieties and pricing data from Azure.
Built the GoSmarter product for NightingaleHQ end-to-end using React on the front end and .NET with Azure Functions on the back end, containerized and deployed to Azure with GitHub Actions CI/CD.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
bullets: Led a project to overhaul the authentication system, improving accessibility and overall user experience.
Executed changes to streamline user access, contributing to a projected 33% increase in user retention for Amazon Business.
Developed an API for fetching account types from the database and carried it through end-to-end testing and deployment.
Engineered a solution for storing and retrieving account types in the authentication service.
Contributed across the software development lifecycle, from specification and design through rollout and maintenance.
Worked with senior engineers on design, coding, testing, and long-term maintainability.

projects.name: AR-Dine
bullets: Built an AI-powered AR restaurant menu and ordering platform with separated customer and owner flows.
Implemented Google OAuth authentication, Stripe payment processing (card, UPI, cash), and real-time order tracking with a state machine.
Designed an 8-service Docker Compose architecture with Express API, BullMQ worker, PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO, ClamAV, and OpenTelemetry.
Automated 3D dish model generation using Gemini AI with a decoupled BullMQ worker pipeline.
Created Azure deployment infrastructure with Bicep IaC, CI/CD via GitHub Actions, and a Helm chart for Kubernetes (AKS/EKS/GKE).
Implemented security measures including JWT auth, rate limiting, ClamAV malware scanning, CSP headers, and parameterized SQL queries.

projects.name: Security Audit Framework
bullets: Built a comprehensive 7-phase security audit framework covering 12 security layers from architecture to business logic.
Documented 27 attack patterns across identity, application, infrastructure, network, supply chain, and client-side categories.
Created STRIDE threat modeling templates, risk scoring calculators, and remediation guides for common vulnerability classes.
Mapped findings to OWASP Top 10, NIST CSF, CIS Controls v8, and SOC 2 compliance standards.

projects.name: ChatPDF
bullets: Built a chat application that lets users interact with PDF documents through context-aware conversations.
Implemented PDF upload and chat creation workflows around uploaded documents.
Integrated the OpenAI API to generate responses tailored to the active document and chat context.
Used PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM for efficient data interactions and persistence.
Worked with a stack that included TypeScript, Next.js, AWS, and Pinecone vector database.

projects.name: KitchenWiz
bullets: Built an AI-powered kitchen assistant mobile app using Expo and React Native.
Integrated Google Gemini AI API for intelligent recipe suggestions and kitchen management features.
Developed backend services and database layer for persistent user data.

projects.name: StockTally
bullets: Built a stock and inventory tracking application using Next.js and Prisma ORM.
Designed data models and schema for product and inventory management.
Styled with Tailwind CSS for a responsive user interface.

projects.name: Preserving Heritage
bullets: Built a computer vision project to identify and support preservation of heritage sites using satellite imagery.
Trained a CNN-based model for monument identification.
Integrated weather prediction data using a weather API.
Developed the project in a Jupyter Notebook environment using Python and deep learning workflows.
